purpose: Independent pinned CPU GDN F32 dot and scaled-update regression
layout: Little-endian: PGDN001 NUL; u32 dot-case count, u32 row-case count; each dot: u32 width, u32 native-result bits, width F32 x, width F32 y; each row: u32 width, F32 v, F32 native-output, width F32 q/k/initial-state/native-updated-state
notes: Complete captures and script retained externally in the session evidence lane.
Rows are extracted from independent native one-head, one-token, one-sequence D128 GDN execution with g=0, beta=1 and raw gates disabled.
A row update/output depends only on that initial state row and the shared q/k plus corresponding v value.
Expected bits come from native output buffers; no model weights were loaded.
This operator fixture does not establish full-model numerical parity.
